use_case_and_requirements: Workloads: high-concurrency support-agent chat (multi-tenant), nightly document indexing + embeddings, model reranking for search
Throughput targets: sustained 6k-10k tokens/sec across peak window; ability to burst 2x for 30min
Latency SLOs: 95th percentile <200ms for chat generate path; p50 <80ms for embeddings queries
Reserved GPU planning: desire 8 reserved A100-equivalent slots (can be mix of 8x40GB + 4x80GB); capacity must guarantee concurrency targets
Caching/batching: require prefix/KV cache pinned for priority customers; want policy to exclude certain sensitive queries
Model preferences: preference for open Llama-family 70B quantized variants + fallback to smaller, cheaper family under heavy load
Routing/fallback: need automated fallback to cheaper model variant with no more than X% quality degradation SLA (ops metric), and cross-region fallback to EU/NA for DR
Security: VPC-only control plane, KMS integration for key rotation, SOC2/ISO evidence required for contract
sla_requirements: Uptime target: contractual 99.99% monthly for Dedicated cluster; 99.995% for control plane (negotiable)

Credit schedule proposal: tiered credits — 99.99-99.95% = 10% monthly credit; 99.95-99.9% = 25%; below 99.9% escalate to full month credit up to 100% for multi-week outage (legal wants cap removal discussion)

Maintenance windows: prefer quarterly major windows + monthly 1-hour maintenance slot; no maintenance during M-F 08:00-18:00 ET without 14-day notice; emergency maintenance allowed with post-facto remediation plan
Support response times: P0 (critical) 15 minutes phone response + 1 hour remediation plan; P1 1 hour; P2 4 hours; P3 24 hours; dedicated SLA manager during rollouts
SLO measurements: agreed measurement endpoints (per-route token latency, per-node availability) with Redwood-provided monthly reports and per-route tracing
Escalation & runbook: must include named on-call and 24x7 escalation path; request for joint runbook review prior to signing
commercial_notes: Looking for 12-month committed reserved capacity with quarterly review
Pricing sensitivity: wants blended ARR under $1M but willing to stretch for stronger SLA terms
Procurement requests: indemnity language for data residency, right to audit SOC2 reports, and proof of encryption-in-transit and at-rest
risks_and_open_questions: Legal: wants removal of fee cap on credits — Redwood prefers predefined cap; needs compromise language
Ops: Fairwind nightly batch jobs overlap with proposed maintenance windows — need technical mitigation or separate maintenance schedule
Sizing: SE suggests 8 reserved nodes; Fairwind infra team pushing for 12 to meet peak — cost delta unresolved
DR/HA: require cross-region failover playbook and recovery RTO under 1 hour for leaderless workloads
